connector.name: Atlas MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP for stocks, options, Greeks, brokers, order previews, alerts, and workflows.
connector.summary: Hosted at atlasmcp.finmanagerai.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the finmanagerai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
